MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Bring Him Home suggests a musical-theatre connection that makes it a natural choice after Stages and A Musical Affair.",
    "Christmas Together, Holiday Wishes and That's Christmas To Me connect with my past Christmas listening, so they feel relevant for another season."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "I would save the Christmas albums for holiday listening; enjoying that music previously does not mean I want it now.",
    "New Moves / Traces, Awakening, Storyteller, 25 and Love Somebody give me no clear connection to the vocal or relaxing music I want, so I would not choose them without knowing more.",
    "My interest in 747 and Golden does not make a large Toby Keith hits collection an appealing next choice."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The Christmas selections make my past seasonal listening seem more central to my current interests than it is.",
    "The country selections seem to stretch a few past choices into a broader interest than I would act on today."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest choice, The Most Relaxing Classical Music in the Universe, suggests that calm listening deserves more attention.",
    "The connection to musical theatre matters to me: Bring Him Home gives me a specific reason to explore it after Stages and A Musical Affair, while vague titles do not."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The choices recognize my musical-theatre and Christmas interests, but lean too heavily on seasonal listening and give too little weight to my recent interest in relaxing music."
}
